 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Keep the upper-left quarter of the non-background symmetric motif.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells) + 1
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells) + 1
    h, w = r1 - r0, c1 - c0
    return [row[c0:c0 + w // 2] for row in grid[r0:r0 + h // 2]]
"
